title: flightdeck/compliance-config/v1
description: The TOML file that names the repositories a compliance build reads, the imposed rule set and how old a report or run may be before it reads stale.

Audits.description: Where the suites' runs come from.

artifact.description: The artifact's name, for the `github-artifact` kind.

kind.description:
`board`, for suites in the controls repository's own board, or
`github-artifact`.

path.description: The board's directory, for the `board` kind.

AuditsKind.description: The kinds of place the suites' runs come from.

oneOf.description: An artifact of a GitHub Actions run.

Build.description: How often the controls job builds the pages.

every_hours.description: The hours between two builds, which give the next build's time.

ConfigFile.title: flightdeck/compliance-config/v1
ConfigFile.description: A `flightdeck/compliance-config/v1` file, as a person writes it.

audits.description:
Where the suites' runs come from, which the build checks and does
not read.

build.description: How often the controls job builds the pages.

imposed.description:
The imposed rule set that every repository's rules are compared
with.

repositories.description:
Each repository whose report the build reads, in the order the
pages show them.

source.description:
Where each repository's report comes from, unless the repository
names its own source. The build reads only the reports directory,
so it checks the source's shape and `fetch` will read it.

stale_after_days.description:
The most whole days since a report or a suite's run before it reads
stale, 7 when left out.

ImposedFile.description: The imposed rule set, as the config names it.

from.description:
The rules board's origin in identity form, such as
`owner/controls`, which each report's `board.rules_from` must name.

name.description: The set's name for people, such as `platform-controls`.

root.description:
The set's root in the rules board, `/rules` when left out, which
each report's `imposed.root` must name.

RepositoryFile.description: One repository, as the config names it.

group.description: The heading the pages show the repository under.

name.description:
The repository's name, `owner/repo`. Its report is
`<reports>/<owner>/<repo>.json`.

source.description:
Where this repository's report comes from, in place of the
config's `[source]`.

Source.description:
Where a report or a suite's runs come from. The build reads only files;
`flightdeck compliance fetch` will read the other kinds.

branch.description: The branch whose runs count, such as `main`.

path.description: The report's path, for the `path` kind.

url.description: The report's address, for the `url` kind.

workflow.description:
The workflow file whose newest successful run holds the artifact,
such as `ci.yml`.

SourceKind.description: The kinds of place a report comes from.

oneOf.description: An artifact of a GitHub Actions run.
An address that serves the report.
